title: The Driver's Seat

vibeProfile.oneLine: A woman travels south, hunting the stranger who will kill her.

summary: Lise, a woman we are told from the outset will soon be found murdered, flies south on holiday behaving more and more strangely, loudly hunting for a particular kind of man. Spark strips away suspense on purpose, telling us the ending so that the horror lies in watching Lise stage-manage her own fate. Cold, precise and genuinely disturbing, this short novel is one of her strangest and most brilliant, a study of a woman seizing the one form of control left to her.
whyReadIt: A chilling, controlled little novel that tells you the ending and unsettles you anyway. Unlike anything else you will read this year.

funFacts.text: Spark called it her masterpiece; it was filmed with Elizabeth Taylor in the lead.
